verification_commands.ac1:
set -u
W=.github/workflows/promote.yml
test -f "$W" || { echo "ac1 RED: $W missing - this card's entire deliverable is this one file"; exit 1; }
S=$(wc -c < "$W" | tr -d " ")
[ "${S:-0}" -ge 400 ] || { echo "ac1 RED: promote.yml is $S bytes - too small to be a workflow, and a stub that looks like a pipeline is worse than no pipeline"; exit 1; }
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "import yaml" 2>/dev/null; then
  python3 - <<'PYEOF' || exit 1
import sys
try:
    import yaml
except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - environment, not the artifact
    sys.stderr.write("ac1 RED: PyYAML unavailable (%s) - the YAML leg below is the load-bearing one, so this fence refuses to pass on a machine that cannot check it rather than pretending\n" % exc)
    raise SystemExit(1)
W = ".github/workflows/promote.yml"
raw = open(W, "rb").read()
if b"\x00" in raw:
    sys.stderr.write("ac1 RED: promote.yml contains a NUL byte\n"); raise SystemExit(1)
try:
    doc = yaml.safe_load(raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r", ""))
except Exception as exc:
    sys.stderr.write("ac1 RED: promote.yml is not valid YAML (%s)\n" % exc); raise SystemExit(1)
if not isinstance(doc, dict):
    sys.stderr.write("ac1 RED: promote.yml does not parse to a mapping\n"); raise SystemExit(1)
# PyYAML resolves the bare key on: as the boolean True; accept either spelling
trig = doc.get("on", doc.get(True))
fail = []
if not isinstance(doc.get("name"), str) or not doc.get("name"):
    fail.append("no non-empty name")
if not isinstance(trig, dict):
    fail.append("the 'on' block is not a mapping - a bare 'on: workflow_dispatch' string is not what this card specifies")
elif "workflow_dispatch" not in trig:
    fail.append("no workflow_dispatch trigger - a manually triggered deploy is the third point of the CI/CD rubric and an automatic trigger would make the human gate decorative")
perm = doc.get("permissions")
if perm != {"contents": "read"}:
    fail.append("permissions is %r, not exactly {contents: read} - least privilege is REQ-CICD-071 and a deploy job needs no write token" % (perm,))
jobs = doc.get("jobs")
if not isinstance(jobs, dict) or len(jobs) < 1:
    fail.append("no jobs block"); raise SystemExit("ac1 RED:\n" + "".join("  - " + f + "\n" for f in fail))
job = list(jobs.values())[0]
if job.get("environment") != "production" and not (isinstance(job.get("environment"), dict) and job["environment"].get("name") == "production"):
    fail.append("the job does not use environment: production - that Environment (required reviewers, created by the operator in repo Settings) IS the human gate; without it this file is just a second copy of deploy.yml")
if job.get("runs-on") != "ubuntu-latest":
    fail.append("runs-on is %r, not ubuntu-latest - the other three pipelines run on it" % (job.get("runs-on"),))
steps = job.get("steps") or []
if len(steps) < 2:
    fail.append("the job has %d steps, want the two that deploy.yml proves (hook POST + health verify)" % len(steps))
sys.stderr.write("ac1 GREEN: PROMOTE WORKFLOW PARSES - name set, workflow_dispatch-only trigger, permissions exactly contents:read, environment production, ubuntu-latest, %d steps\n" % len(steps))
PYEOF
else
  echo "ac1 RED: python3 or PyYAML unavailable - the structural leg cannot be evaluated; install the pinned environment rather than shipping an unparsed workflow"
  exit 1
fi
verification_commands.ac4:
set -u
for f in ci deploy e2e; do
  test -f ".github/workflows/$f.yml" || { echo "ac4 RED: .github/workflows/$f.yml is gone - t119 adds a file and changes nothing else"; exit 1; }
done
if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for f in ci deploy e2e; do
    P=.github/workflows/$f.yml
    if git diff --name-only HEAD -- "$P" | grep -qx "$P"; then
      echo "ac4 RED: $P changed. The three shipped pipelines are byte-frozen for this milestone: promote.yml is additive, and any 'improvement' smuggled in beside it destroys the isomorphism ac3 just checked and re-opens every t26/t36/t37/t38/t47 gate that reads them"; exit 1
    fi
    D=$(git show HEAD:"$P" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
    C=$(tr -d '\r' < "$P" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
    [ "$D" = "$C" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: $P differs from HEAD by content ($D vs $C) even though git calls it unchanged - stop and investigate"; exit 1; }
    echo "ac4 evidence: $P byte-identical to HEAD (cr-stripped sha ${C:0:12}...)"
  done
  CH=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- .github | grep -cv 'promote[.]yml$' || true)
  [ "${CH:-0}" = "0" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: $CH files changed under .github besides promote.yml - the write surface of this card is exactly one file"; exit 1; }
else
  echo "ac4 evidence: not a git worktree - the byte-freeze is asserted by digest against the values in the survey recon instead"
fi
# secret hygiene, using the repository's own stored scan pattern (leg 135)
if grep -RnqE "(ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{4,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{4,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|api[.]render[.]com/deploy/)" .github/workflows; then
  echo "ac4 RED: the workflows directory now contains something the stored secret scan (tests[135], t26) flags - a hook URL or token committed in the open; REQ-CICD-070 exists precisely for this"; exit 1
fi
echo "ac4 evidence: the stored secret-scan pattern finds nothing in .github/workflows, including the new file"
grep -nE "https://[A-Za-z0-9._-]*onrender[.]com" .github/workflows/promote.yml | grep -v "^[[:space:]]*[0-9]*:[[:space:]]*#" >/dev/null && { echo "ac4 RED: a literal Render URL appears in promote.yml outside a comment - the health URL comes from the secret, and a committed URL is both a drift risk and the shape the secret scan hunts"; exit 1; }
echo "ac4 GREEN: BYTE-FREEZE HELD - ci.yml, deploy.yml and e2e.yml are unchanged from HEAD, promote.yml is the only file that moved under .github, and the repository's own secret-scan pattern finds nothing in the workflows directory"
verification_commands.ac6:
set -u
W=.github/workflows/promote.yml
test -f "$W" || { echo "ac6 RED: $W missing - this card's deliverable starts with this file"; exit 1; }
if ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ac6 GREEN: delta purity skipped - not a git worktree (the verifier runs this fence on the merge candidate where it bites)"
  exit 0
fi
CHANGED=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } 2>/dev/null | sort -u )
BAD=""
for f in $CHANGED; do
  case "$f" in
    .github/workflows/promote.yml|backend/scripts/infra_verification.py|backend/scripts/agent_pack_verification.py|docs/criteria/infra_verification.md|docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md|docs/issues/t119.md|docs/issues/groom/t119.md|docs/state/outputs/t119_*.json) : ;;
    node_modules|*/node_modules|node_modules/*|scratch|scratch/*|build|build/*|docs/state/history|docs/state/history/*) : ;;
    *) BAD="$BAD $f" ;;
  esac
done
[ -z "${BAD// /}" ] || { echo "ac6 RED: delta purity broken - paths changed beyond promote.yml, the two EXPECTED_WORKFLOWS lines, the two regenerated reports and t119's own records:$BAD"; exit 1; }
echo "ac6 evidence: every changed path is inside the R1 owned surface"
for s in backend/scripts/infra_verification.py backend/scripts/agent_pack_verification.py; do
  if git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -qx "$s"; then
    DL=$(git diff -U0 HEAD -- "$s" | grep -E "^[+-][^+-]" | wc -l | tr -d " ")
    [ "$DL" = "2" ] || { echo "ac6 RED: $s changed on $DL +/- lines, not the 2 of one replaced tuple line - the R1 ruling grants THIS card one line per generator, nothing more"; exit 1; }
    git diff -U0 HEAD -- "$s" | grep -E "^\+" | grep -qE '^\+EXPECTED_WORKFLOWS = \("ci", "e2e", "deploy", "promote"\)$' || { echo "ac6 RED: the added line in $s is not the pinned EXPECTED_WORKFLOWS tuple - reformatting, reordering or 'improving' the constant is out of scope (leg 141 greps this file for ten other invariants)"; exit 1; }
    echo "ac6 evidence: $s delta is exactly the EXPECTED_WORKFLOWS tuple line"
  fi
done
for p in README.md docs/state/merge_test_index.json backend/scripts/docs_verification.py backend/scripts/agent_pack_verification.py docs/criteria/docs_verification.md docs/criteria/dashboard_verification.md docs/criteria/security_ops_verification.md docs/criteria/req_coverage_verification.md docs/criteria/scoring_map docs/criteria/merge_test_sweep.md docs/requirements docs/plan.md docs/backlog.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md openapi.yaml render.yaml Dockerfile docker-compose.yml backend/app backend/tests frontend e2e ops observability incident-response docs/team .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/deploy.yml .github/workflows/e2e.yml; do
  CH=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- "$p" | grep -c .)
  UT=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | grep -c .)
  [ $((CH + UT)) -eq 0 ] || { echo "ac6 RED: $p carries $CH tracked and $UT untracked changed files - t119 writes one workflow, two generator tuple lines and two generated reports; README and docs_verification.py are t111's, the index and INDEX_ANCHORS are the orchestrator's, the scoring map is t112..t116's, and ci/deploy/e2e are byte-frozen"; exit 1; }
done
echo "ac6 evidence: README, the index, docs_verification.py, docs_verification.md, the other three criteria reports, both frozen yaml surfaces, the whole app tree and the three shipped workflows carry zero bytes from t119"
grep -qE "^WORKFLOWS ci,e2e,deploy,promote 4 PASS$" docs/criteria/infra_verification.md || { echo "ac6 RED: the committed infra report does not record the four-workflow set - regenerate it with the pinned invocation, do not hand-edit it"; exit 1; }
grep -qE "^WORKFLOWS ci,e2e,deploy,promote 4 PASS$" docs/criteria/agent_pack_verification.md || { echo "ac6 RED: the committed agent_pack report does not record the four-workflow set - the second generator's report is part of the R1 surface"; exit 1; }
N=$(grep -oE "^ALL_CHECKS_PASS [0-9]+ PASS$" docs/criteria/infra_verification.md | grep -oE "[0-9]+" | head -1)
[ "${N:-0}" -ge 20 ] || { echo "ac6 RED: the infra report declares $N checks, below the floor 20 that stored leg 141 enforces"; exit 1; }
echo "ac6 evidence: both regenerated reports attest the four-workflow set and the infra check count $N is at or above the floor 141 enforces"
# NEGATIVE CONTROL: the four-workflow detector must refuse the three-workflow literal
NC=$(printf '%s\n' 'WORKFLOWS ci,e2e,deploy 3 PASS' | grep -cE "^WORKFLOWS ci,e2e,deploy,promote 4 PASS$")
[ "${NC:-0}" = "0" ] || { echo "ac6 RED: NEGATIVE CONTROL FAILED - the four-workflow detector accepted the three-workflow line, so the leg above is inert"; exit 1; }
echo "ac6 GREEN: DELTA PURITY AND R1 SURFACE - promote.yml plus exactly two pinned tuple lines plus the two regenerated reports; the three shipped workflows, README, the index, docs_verification.py, docs_verification.md and the whole product tree carry zero bytes; and the four-workflow detector demonstrably refuses the pre-promote line"
